prerequisites.text: You must hold a valid Idaho hunting license to apply for any controlled hunt (not a nongame license or hunting passport).
prerequisites.quote: Any person with a valid Idaho hunting license may apply for a controlled hunt, subject to the following restrictions

prerequisites.text: Nonresidents must buy a 2027 Idaho hunting license (valid for big game) before applying in the nonresident deer/elk draw; 2027 licenses go on sale Dec. 1, 2026. License and application fees are not refunded.
prerequisites.quote: All nonresidents are required to purchase a 2027 Idaho hunting license, valid for big game, to be eligible to apply in the draw. 2027 licenses go on sale December 1, 2026.

prerequisites.text: Hunter education is required to buy a hunting license if born on or after January 1, 1975, unless previously licensed in Idaho or another state.
prerequisites.quote: all hunters must show proof that they have completed a hunter education course if they were born on or after January 1, 1975

prerequisites.text: Applying for moose, bighorn sheep or mountain goat bars you from other first-period big game controlled hunts that year (with exceptions); only one of those species per year.
prerequisites.quote: A person may apply for only one species. Any person applying for any moose, bighorn sheep, or mountain goat hunt is prohibited from applying for any other big game controlled hunt in the same year.

prerequisites.text: Mountain goat is once in a lifetime (since 1977); bighorn sheep and moose drawn applicants wait two years; harvested antlered moose bars antlered moose in the first drawing.
prerequisites.quote: Any person who has killed a mountain goat in Idaho since 1977 may not apply for a mountain goat tag.

notes: Idaho has no preference or bonus points, so pointOnly is empty. 2027 dates are published only for the nonresident general-season deer/elk draw (2027 Nonresident Supplement, Oct 2026). No closing time is printed for Dec. 15 or Feb. 15; draw results are given only as 'Early January 2027' and 'Early March 2027'. Tag purchase deadlines: Jan. 20, 2027 (first draw) and Mar. 20, 2027 (second). Controlled-hunt dates are from the 2026 Big Game booklet (2027 booklet due April 2027) and the 2025 & 2026 Moose/Sheep/Goat booklet; recorded as 2026/last_year. Resident general deer/elk tags are over the counter (no draw). Spring bear and Super Hunt left out. All idfg.idaho.gov HTML pages returned HTTP 503 'website undergoing maintenance' on 2026-11-04, so the agency web pages (fee pages, controlled-hunt page, nonresident draw page) could not be read; everything here comes from official IDFG PDFs that were still served. Fees are from the 2026 booklets; nonresident prices are labeled 'as of December 1, 2024'. Resident prices shown without Price Lock. Online/phone purchases add a credit card fee (3% plus $4.00 online).
